about_the_game:
Attention Officers,

Presenting the Eximius Exclusive Callsign Pack - Signs Of Destiny
Equip unique callsigns that are exclusive to this DLC and stand out among the others.

All items in this bundle are purely cosmetics and does not affect gameplay in any way.
You can find the following digital items:

- 5 Exclusive Officer Callsigns
- 1 Exclusive Officer Callsign Frame
- 1 Exclusive Team Banner to be displayed at various locations in game by Team Commanders
- A Soundtrack Album composed by Nir Shor

* Soundtracks can be found in the Eximius Installation Folder.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains Violence and Blood

short_description: EXIMIUS is a FPS/RTS hybrid that focuses on squad-based combat. The game features an intense 5v5 multiplayer experience with each team comprising of 4 Squad Officers and one Commander.
